sanskrit_verse: vikrītam api vikreyaṃ pūrvakretary agṛhṇati / hāniś cet kretṛdoṣeṇa kretur eva hi sā bhavet // YajñS_2.255
transliteration: vikrītam api vikreyaṁ pūrvakretari agṛhṇati / hāniś cet kretṛdoṣeṇa kretur eva hi sā bhavet // YajñS_2.255
sph_interpretive_translation: Even if sold, property remains recoverable by the prior owner if the purchaser knowingly accepts it without due inquiry; loss caused by the fault of the acquirer shall revert to the acquirer alone.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority inheres in the original possessor until valid transfer is established
Causation is assigned through conscious awareness of transactional integrity
Capacity-based responsibility lies with the party exercising dominion without verification
Restoration logic requires return of value to its rightful consciousness-aligned holder
Consciousness alignment demands that knowing participation activates full liability
executable_legal_axioms: IF asset_transfer_occurs AND prior_owner_has_not_relinquished_conscious_claim AND new_holder_knowingly_accepted THEN reversal_of_title_is_automatic
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving contested transfers, the Supreme Court must prioritize the ontological status of ownership rooted in dharmic continuity over procedural formalism. The threshold of responsibility is determined not by temporal sequence but by the acquirer's conscious engagement with the legitimacy of the transaction.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that knowledge of defect renders the receiver complicit in disorder; anupūrvaśaḥ dictates that consequence follows cognition. Responsibility aligns proportionally to the degree of intentional acceptance. No punitive outcome is mandated—only correction of misaligned dominion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process wherein defective acquisition is nullified automatically upon detection by competent authority
Assign responsibility assumption protocol to acquiring party requiring acknowledgment and restitution without external coercion
Implement capacity restoration for both parties ensuring no residual distortion from flawed exchange
Execute integrity reintegration through ceremonial or legal affirmation of corrected ownership state
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism as Law: Ownership derives from consciousness, not mere transaction. Fault-aligned loss returns to its source without infliction. Dharma stands restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate arbiter.
